description: Golden evaluation set for the enterprise RAG agent. Retrieval cases name the documents that contain the answer; answer_keywords are facts that must appear in a correct answer; the final case must produce an abstention because no document covers it. Tool cases check that the agent picks the right action.

cases.question: How many days of annual leave do employees get and how many days can be carried over?
cases.notes: Two numbers plus a deadline: tests multi-fact retrieval inside one section.

cases.notes: No document covers equity. The right behaviour is an abstention, not a guess.
